notes.note: Typed LaTeX lecture notes by the instructor, one PDF per lecture and per exam review (25), plus an all-in-one PDF. Transcribed page by page to raw/notes/ with the mathematics in LaTeX. There are no slides: the lectures are given at the blackboard.

figureAudit.note: false because no visual audit was run, not because something is unchecked: the transcribed notes (Lectures 1 and 2) contain no figures. Every equation in both notes transcriptions was compared against the PDF's text layer in the parent; the prose was taken from the text layer, which is clean for pdfTeX output.

caveats: Covers Lectures 1 and 2 only (videos 1-2 of 25: 23 lectures and two exam reviews). Topic pages reflect those two lectures only.

The course takes for granted, without proof, that a complete ordered field containing Q exists (Lecture 2); the KB does not supply a proof. Lower bounds, and sequences and limits, are deferred by Lecture 2 to later lectures not yet in this KB.

Transcripts are a light copy-edit of OCW's professional captions; uncertain spots are marked [Ed: ...], and the verbatim captions are kept in raw/transcripts/original/. Student speech is marked only where the captions label it.

The lecture notes transcriptions were read from page images by Sonnet; the parent checked every equation against the PDF text layer. Printed typos are listed per notes file under 'Printed slips', not corrected in the body.
